errors.evidence: The description claims the x-axis categories are arranged in alphabetical order, but they are not. The order is 'големи стопанства', 'растениевъдни', 'животновъдни', etc., which is not alphabetical in Bulgarian.
The description misquotes two of the category labels. The chart shows 'растениевъдни' and 'животновъдни', not 'растителни дейности' and 'животновъдни дейности'.
The description states the bars are colored in shades of pink, but they are clearly orange in the figure.
